name: Create Property Marketing Photo
description: Upload a marketing photo to a multi-family residential property. Marketing photos are not available for single-family residential properties.

pathParams.name: PropertyId
pathParams.description: The property to which the marketing photo will be attached

attributes.name: Position
attributes.description: The position of the photo in the property marketing photo gallery. The position must be a non-negative integer. If multiple photos are associated with a property, the order of the remaining photos (positions 1 and above) will not change automatically if some photos are deleted.

responseFields.name: Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the property marketing photo
